faucet: koru regression snapshots (test-results/*.json — passed/inScope per snapshot)
generator: models/breath/faucet.mjs (reads real test-results/*.json in chronological order, no synthesis)
split_basis: calendar — chosen BEFORE looking at where any divergence falls
out_of_sample: snapshots from 2026-05-01 onward (the mature period) — open-ended; the tail grows as the faucet drinks
signal: pass_rate (summary.passRate); the breath is its trajectory over snapshots
depth_floor_rationale: A real inhale is >= 8 points below the best-ever rate; normal oscillation is shallower. Checked: depth_floor of 8/10/12pp all satisfy the contract; 8 gives the widest in-sample-vs-OOS separation (IS max dip run 12 ticks vs OOS 38), so it is the most robust, least knife-edge choice.
dur_threshold_rationale: Design constant = 1.5x the longest in-sample sustained-dip run (12 ticks). Sits above any in-sample breath so an active dev inhale never false-fires; trips only on a sustained inhale longer than the bring-up ever showed. NOT tuned to where the OOS divergence lands.
expected_real_fire: The long May inhale: pass-rate held >= 8pp below its running peak for far longer than any in-sample breath (OOS dip run reaches ~38 ticks). First OOS fire around idx 250 (2026-05-07).
stateful: peak (high-water of the breath) and dip_ticks (consecutive ticks held deep) are carried across ticks — the carried state is what distinguishes a deep-for-weeks inhale from a one-tick mid-run snapshot artifact.
notes: Inhale = pass-rate falling (outpacing the suite); exhale = rising (pruning/fixing). The watcher reasons over the SUSTAINED inhale, not any single drop. Surprise = dip_ticks (how long the current inhale has been held).
